Lets{{sic}} see how you fair{{sic}} against my legion of pawns!|audio = FailedGatewayWave1-2-3.ogg|[[Titus (Narrator)|Titus]] on Wave 1 (Formerly, [[Failed Gateway]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Quick Pawn''' was the first enemy that appeared in [[Failed Gateway]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had a very high speed and low health, occasionally appearing with the [[Bloated]] and [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attributes. ==Appearance== The '''Quick Pawn''' was a wooden construct with a brown body. It had dark brown cloth around its legs and a bandolier. It wore multiple pieces of grey metal armor, consisting of knee-pads, shoulder-pads and elbow-pads, all with spikes on them. It also had a metal head piece with wires and a lens on its head. ==Strategy== *'''Quick Pawns''' are weak enemies that can be dealt with by a majority of early game towers, such as the [[Crook Boss]], [[Golden Soldier]] and [[Brawler]]. **As they spawn in groups, towers that can damage multiple enemies at once are effective against them. **They can also be easily slowed down by slowing towers like the [[Cryomancer]]. *In Hard mode, some '''Quick Pawns''' will spawn with the [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attribute. **Towers with a fast firerate like the [[Minigunner]] can be used to deal with this. **Units' collision damage is a great way to deal with [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] '''Quick Pawns'''. Similarly, the [[Trapper]]'s traps will deal heavy damage to them. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.2.0GenericThumbnail8.png|'''Quick Pawn''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Video}} The Hexscape Trailer (HALLOWEEN) - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Quick Pawn''' on a promotional video. }} ==Update History== *'''23 October 2024''' - [[v1.37.0]] **'''Quick Pawn''' added. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Quick Pawn''' removed. {{FailedGateway|Start|N/A|Quick Pawn & [[Pawn]]|Wave 1|[[Brain Bound]]|Wave 2}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
